lines: We were supposed to sprint off on the count, so why?
It’s as if I alone am the sabotage.
I live vaguely between yes and no.
A nasty habit that sticks to me.
That can’t be true.
After all, I’ve collected the things and people I love.
That thing—what was it.
Somehow, now.
I even feel I’d rather love than be loved.
I wonder if it’s still in time.
I carve it so I won’t vanish just as I am.
We’re usually alike, so why?
After all, I’m the only one sabotaging.
What’s a mistake made once or twice?
If you count: one, two, three, four (five, six, seven, eight)
Then rise up, saying it starts here.
The things and people I love.
Gather them and go.
While being overtaken.
I found a fragment of my own self.
I wonder if it’s still in time.
I carve it so I won’t vanish just as I am.
Even if I can’t do anything or have nothing.
I realized that the chase right now is fun.
I’m certainly feeling light.
But I’m shining.
Ah, I’m alive.
Somehow, now.
I even feel I’d rather love than be loved.
I wonder if it’s still in time.
I don’t want to vanish just as I am.
That this is me.
If only a little.
Now I can say it with confidence.
